drafts.reply: Compute growth at 3.4× a year turns electricity supply and cooling into the binding constraints, so placement follows cheap reliable power instead of chip availability.
Single issuer capture of the 197M ETH inflow concentrates redemption risk compared with the multi fund 463M BTC outflow.
Selling Bitcoin ETF shares along with Circle and Coinbase as equities advanced can free capital for other themes without implying a crypto downturn.
Gross margins on AI products compress when tokens per user rise faster than pricing power even if the cluster itself is rented.
One session of ETF flow data omits leverage and custody rotation, so the 282 million Bitcoin outflow cannot define relative strength versus XRP.
Grayscale converting a trust to a spot ETF still leaves the SEC review period intact and does not guarantee inflows once listed.
Staking lockups and ETF custody are not equivalent because ETF coins can return via redemptions while staked ETH faces exit queues.
A home lab GPU is a depreciating capital outlay. It still leaves training data, evals, and weight provenance as claims you did not independently produce.
Data center collateral depends on grid interconnection queues and hyperscaler concentration rather than the occupancy and cap rate assumptions that price other CRE.
A procedural vote does not change custody treatment or bank capital rules. historically legislative catalysts have followed price recovery rather than led it.
Market cap adjusted comparisons omit that bitcoin retains deeper order books and lower slippage for large tickets.
Onchain betting still collides with gambling laws that a predictions layer cannot rewrite.
Single session inflows after a week of bleeding leave net weekly positioning mixed and often reverse once the vote is decided.
Amazon already designs its own Trainium and Inferentia chips so this collaboration likely targets complementary workloads rather than replacement.
Overnight futures will price the 2:15 PM EST vote before the cash open. The 5 trading day inflow pattern does not set that sequence.
MSTR funds purchases with corporate credit while IBIT grows through share creation. Most Bitcoin still sits outside both vehicles so those holdings do not exhaust supply for other buyers.
Crossing 1 billion in five weeks does not prove the market will retain liquidity after launch promotions end.
Obtaining a 1200 Ethos score already requires prior onchain activity whose costs the 200 and 15-20 min pitch never subtract.
Distributed consumer GPUs still lack the interconnect density and guaranteed uptime that large training runs need.
